newsitem.title: UK: FTSE cuts losses as Dow rises amid choppy session.
newsitem.headline: FTSE cuts losses as Dow rises amid choppy session.

text.p: UK shares finished lower on Friday but well above the day's worst levels as Wall Street stocks turned higher after a choppy start in New York.

The FTSE, still under the spell of Wall Street after last Friday's sell-off, ended 18.3 points lower at 3,972.4. At its worst the index had slipped to 3,933. Mid-250 stocks also finished lower, shedding 21.2 points to 4,358.3.
A turbulent session in New York overnight encouraged many investors in London to stay on the sidelines until U.S. stocks showed signs of stabilising.
Trading volume was a modest 560 million shares.
